# TinyUSB source subset

This directory contains the device core, bare-metal OSAL, common FIFO support,
and DFU mode class driver from TinyUSB commit
`32530d8f4b6cd6d6f7a7df7e6358856c7ebc4f5e`.

Upstream: <https://github.com/hathach/tinyusb>

Pinned source: <https://github.com/hathach/tinyusb/commit/32530d8f4b6cd6d6f7a7df7e6358856c7ebc4f5e>

The upstream MIT license is preserved in `LICENSE` and `LICENSES/MIT.txt`.
